d:
The Rockets defeated the Bucks, 132-100 tonight in Milwaukee. Fred VanVleet contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 6 rebounds 5 assists and 4 three pointers, with Amen Thompson of the Rockets adding an additional 23 points (10-16 FG) in the game. Tyler Herro finished with a team-high 23 points along with 4 three pointers for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 5-0 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-4 for the season.
